answer: Require every agent identity to post a stake that unlocks slowly as it completes verified work, so creating a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand stakes. An attacker facing an ocean of cheap identities must fund each one, while honest agents grow their orchard of reputation over time: completed tasks, peer attestations, and clean history raise trust and lower fees. New identities start in an umber, low-trust tier with capped payouts and slow withdrawals, so a sybil swarm earns little before its stake is slashed for bad work.
